paragraphs.text:
Something crashes through the woods behind you. It does not 
sound like the Sylvia you knew.

Make a Hard CON roll for Norman. Then, make a Regular CON 
roll for yourself. If you both succeed, go to 513. If you fail, go to 337. 
If you succeed, but Norman fails, go to 336.
